newsitem.title: UK: Shell Expro sees Aug Brent slightly down on month.
newsitem.headline: Shell Expro sees Aug Brent slightly down on month.

text.p: Brent system operator Shell Exploration and Production (Shell Expro) on Tuesday estimated North Sea Brent crude system throughput in August at 407,800 barrels per day (bpd), slightly lower than the 409,076 bpd pumped in July.
Shell Expro also confirmed the postponed maintenance shutdown of its 70,000 bpd Brent Bravo field originally due June 1-7 would now go ahead from August 18-24.
A shutdown of the Auk platform which had been planned from August 8-12 was no longer required.
Average Brent pipeline throughput in the 12 months to the end of June was 437,694 bpd, Shell said.
Shell Expro is a joint venture between Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.

Brent system throughput includes crude produced from 13 fields and several satellite wells piped to the Sullom Voe terminal in the Shetland Islands, where it is blended with Ninian crude and exported as Brent Blend.
Shell Expro said the throughput forecast was subject to the progress of maintenance work, associated engineering and normal operational considerations and may be "subject to significant fluctuation".
